source2 = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Decode patch colors from the marked intersections of a repeated grid."""
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = next(value for value, _ in counts.most_common() if value != background)

    separator_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                      if sum(value != background for value in row) > width / 2]
    dense_cols = [c for c in range(width)
                  if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(height)) > height / 2]
    separator_cols = [c for c in dense_cols
                      if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, line_color)
                             for r in range(height))]

    output = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(separator_rows, separator_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(separator_cols, separator_cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else background)
        output.append(row)
    return output
'''
